title: Austin Improves Roads, Settles Lawsuit
summary:
*   Approved significant street paving projects on Brazos and Colorado Streets.
*   Authorized a $255.55 payment to Mrs. Lelia P. Grant to settle a legal judgment for damages against the city.
*   The meeting recessed early out of respect for the Mayor following the death of his sister.
transcript:
414
..Regular meeting of the City Council : Austin, Texas, January 13, 1916: The Council was
called to order by the Mayor : Roll called: Present Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony ,
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Absent none.

On motion the readings of the minutes was postponed until the next regular meeting of the
Council : Councilman Powell offered the following resolution: Resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin, Texas : That the Supt of Streets and Public Improvements of the
City of Austin, Paving Brazos Texas , be and he is hereby authorized and instructed to
order ,by the proper St ordered legal procedure , the paving of Brazos street in this City
from the alley between 10th & 11th streets to the north side of 11th street in this City.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Councilman Powell offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin, Texas : That the Supt of Streets and Public Improvements of the City of
Austin, Texas, be and he is hereby authorized and instructed to order ,by the proper
Paving Colorado legal procedure , the paving of Colorado street in this City from the
north Street side of 9th street to the south side of 11th street.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Councilman Powell offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin, Texas : That the sum of $ 250.00 and $ 5.55 ,cost of court ,or a total of
$ 255.55, be and the same is hereby appropriated out of the General Street Improvement
fund of the City of Austin, Texas , for the year 1916, in payment of an agreed Lelia Grant
judgement against the City of Austin in favor of Mrs Lelia P Grant, in cause Damages. No
32347, entitled Mrs Lelia P Grant vs The City of Austin in the Dist Court of Travis Co
Texas.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Councilman Bartholomew moved that the Council recess, out of respect to the Mayor, on
account of the Death of his Sister. which motion prevailed.
